image_description: A turtle with a high-domed, dark greyish-brown carapace featuring distinct scute patterns and faint longitudinal ridges. The head is reddish-brown with yellow striping on the neck and side of the face. The limbs are visible, showing orange/reddish scales and webbed feet with claws. The turtle is situated on a forest floor covered in dry leaves and twigs.
